title: US National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross leaves; Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies named to replace him
org: Office of the National Cyber Director
summary: Anadolu reports a White House official confirmed that National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross is leaving, and that Secretary of State Marco Rubio congratulated Pentagon CIO Kirsten Davies as the new director. Gizmodo calls her acting director. Axios, as relayed by both outlets, cites White House officials saying Stephen Miller pushed for the removal over cyber credentials; this reason is unconfirmed.
plain: The person who coordinates US government cyber policy is leaving, and the Pentagon's chief information officer has been named to take over.
exec: Leadership change at the White House cyber office; it may affect national cyber policy and coordination.

key_findings: A White House official confirmed Cairncross's departure to Anadolu.
Rubio posted congratulations to Kirsten Davies as the new National Cyber Director; Gizmodo calls her acting director.
The reason is not officially stated; Axios reports Miller pushed for removal (unconfirmed).

validation.note: Anadolu Agency and Gizmodo, independent publishers, both report the departure and Davies's role; the reason for the departure is Axios reporting only.
